title: A project video keeps a connection open for hours, starving pictures and videos
description: MPI-1137's [slow-load] log, Fabio's app 2026-10-14: /project-file ref2v_002.mp4 (Qwen 2.1) held a connection 07:01-09:50Z (download 6706 s, status 0 = aborted at the end), plus holds of 15-32 s. With 3 of Chromium's 6 per-host sockets taken by permanent EventSources, one long hold leaves 2 for every image and video: the leading suspect for the slow landing / blank cards after a long idle. Find the element that keeps loading it and make it let go.
